summary: FASE P1-FETCH-MIGRATION Testing: Login/Logout work correctly. Authentication tokens are being sent properly (no Bearer null/undefined). However, CRITICAL BUG found: 4 files have double /api/ prefix causing 404 errors. Files using fetchWithAuth('/api/...') with api.js (which already has /api baseURL) result in /api/api/... URLs.

integration_issues.issue: Double /api/ prefix in URLs causing 404 errors
integration_issues.details: Files using fetchWithAuth('/api/...') with api.js client result in /api/api/... URLs. Example: fetchWithAuth('/api/finanzas/dashboard') becomes https://...com/api/api/finanzas/dashboard (404)
integration_issues.fix_required: Remove '/api' prefix from all fetchWithAuth calls. Change fetchWithAuth('/api/finanzas/...') to fetchWithAuth('/finanzas/...')

issues: HTML nesting warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> - hydration error in select options

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix double /api/ prefix in 4 files (Finanzas.js, RecursosHumanos.js, MisTareas.js, Nominas.js)
Remove '/api' prefix from all fetchWithAuth() calls - paths should be '/finanzas/...' not '/api/finanzas/...'
Correctly migrated files (Proveedores.js, ImportadorRH.js) use paths like '/portal/admin/...' and '/rrhh/importar/...' without /api prefix
critical_code_review_comments: api.js baseURL is already '${BACKEND_URL}/api', so endpoint paths should NOT include /api prefix
Proveedores.js and ImportadorRH.js are correctly migrated (no /api prefix in paths)
Finanzas.js, RecursosHumanos.js, MisTareas.js, Nominas.js have incorrect /api prefix in fetchWithAuth calls
Authentication is working correctly - Bearer tokens are valid JWT tokens
